# Which games earn their floor space, and which should you move or cut?

> Free arcade game payback calculator: plays, credits, ticket payout, floor space and upkeep become weekly profit, payback, break-even plays and a keep, watch or cut verdict for every game. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
